title: Using Amigo with Microsoft Teams | Amigo — AI Career Companion & Interview Copilot
description: Connect Amigo to Microsoft Teams interviews. Setup, audio routing, and tips for an undetectable real-time AI copilot during live calls.
html:
Microsoft Teams is standard at enterprise companies and many consulting firms. Amigo works with both the classic Teams desktop client and the new Teams (2024+). Stealth Mode is fully effective with all Teams screen-sharing methods.

Setup

  1. Install the Amigo desktop app; see the Installation guide.
  2. On macOS, grant Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
  3. Open Amigo and sign in with your Amigo account. The system readiness check will run automatically. Check your audio device in Settings → Audio if needed.
  4. Download and install Microsoft Teams if not already installed (Teams web app also works; see below).
  5. Launch Amigo first, then open Teams and join your meeting.

On Windows, if Teams is running as a work or school account with company-managed device policies, the IT policy may restrict which applications can run alongside Teams. Check with your interviewer's company if you are connecting from a corporate-managed machine.

Screen Sharing in Teams

Teams offers several sharing modes, all compatible with Amigo's Stealth Mode:

  • Desktop: Your full desktop is shared, but Amigo's overlay is excluded by the OS. The interviewer sees your desktop without the Amigo panel.
  • Window: Only the selected application window is shared. Amigo is never in scope.
  • PowerPoint Live: Presentation mode; your screen is not shared. Amigo works normally in the background.
  • Whiteboard: Uses Teams' built-in whiteboard; Amigo is not captured.

Using Teams in a Browser

If you join a Teams meeting via the web app (teams.microsoft.com) instead of the desktop client, Amigo still works. Browser-based Teams uses the same system audio path that Amigo taps into.

  • Chrome and Edge are recommended. Firefox has limited support for Teams web features.
  • Screen sharing from a browser tab is isolated to that tab; Amigo is not captured.
  • Audio quality may be slightly lower in the web app compared to the desktop client.

Known Issues

  • Teams background noise suppression: Teams applies aggressive noise cancellation by default. If transcription quality is poor, go to Teams Settings → Devices → Noise suppression and set it to Low or Off.
  • macOS: Teams audio routing: Some macOS versions route Teams audio through a virtual device. If Amigo isn't capturing audio during a Teams call, go to Settings → Audio and select "Microsoft Teams Audio" as the monitored device.
  • New Teams on Windows 11: The new Teams client (2024+) is fully supported. No additional steps required.

Teams' "Record this meeting" feature records the call audio server-side and creates a transcript via Microsoft's AI. This is separate from Amigo, and neither affects the other.
